skills.name: Common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with different denominators by renaming them with a common denominator.

skills.name: Mixed/whole subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract whole numbers and mixed numbers by separating whole-number and fractional parts when no borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Regrouping in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Rename one whole as an equivalent fraction when subtracting from a whole number or from a smaller fractional part.

skills.name: Improper-fraction handling
skills.definition: Interpret, convert, or normalize improper fractions and mixed numbers with improper fractional parts.
